name: playbook-jupi
description: Playbook-Jupi — closed-world playbook engine, forked from proactive-jupi. Runs a declared process: fixed account dossiers traverse a funnel defined by a co-constructed playbook; every hole in the playbook surfaces as a ready-to-settle Jupi decision; validated decisions become rules that graduate steps from ask-every-time to act (draft-gated). Includes a bootstrap skill that creates the playbook store, the dossiers, and runs the playbook extraction.
